summary: Phase 3 final testing. Backend: /api/upload accepts image and returns url; POST /api/misc-expenses persists receipt_url; PUT /api/duty-entries/{id}/correct returns success + audit_logs_created=1 and GET /api/audit-logs contains admin_user/driver_id/entry_date/field_changed/old_value/new_value/reason/corrected_at; GET /api/payroll returns holiday_worked_pay & weekly_off_worked_pay along with base_salary, total_overtime_amount, total_conveyance, total_dinner, total_breakfast, total_expenses, total_bonuses, total_advances, leave_deductions, loan_deductions, net_pay. Admin frontend: /payroll/{driverId}/{y}/{m} renders 'Salary Slip' with 'Holiday Worked Additional Pay' + 'Weekly Off Worked Additional Pay' rows, Miscellaneous Expenses line, Download PDF button, Day-by-Day table with pencil/Edit Correct action opening modal with Work Status dropdown (present/vacation/outstation/holiday_worked/weekly_off_worked), Correction Reason * mandatory, Save Correction. Driver frontend: /driver/expenses shows Receipt/Photo (Optional) file input with accept='image/jpeg,image/jpg,image/png' and max 2MB label. Admin ExpenseManagement code shows '📎 View Receipt' link when expense.receipt_url exists. HIGH gap: /driver/payroll (MyPayroll.js) has NO Download PDF button - pdfGenerator only imported by admin PayrollView.js, so Phase 3 Feature 1 (Driver downloads PDF salary slip) is not wired on the driver page.
passed: POST /api/upload (auth: driver) returns 200 with url /api/files/<uuid>.jpg (compression works, PNG -> JPG)
POST /api/misc-expenses persists receipt_url (verified via response payload)
GET /api/audit-logs returns entries with admin_user=9999999999, field_changed, old_value, new_value, reason, corrected_at
GET /api/payroll/{id}/{y}/{m} exposes holiday_worked_pay & weekly_off_worked_pay plus base_salary/net_pay and all totals
Admin PayrollView UI: 'Salary Slip', 'Holiday Worked Additional Pay', 'Weekly Off Worked Additional Pay', 'Miscellaneous Expenses', 'Day-by-Day Payroll Details', 'Download PDF' button all render
Admin PayrollView day-by-day table has Edit-icon Correct button; clicking opens 'Correct Duty Entry' modal with Work Status select (5 options), mandatory Correction Reason, Save Correction
Driver MiscExpenses page has file input for receipt (accept=image/jpeg,jpg,png)
Admin login (9999999999/admin123) and Driver login (8888888888/driver123) both work
POST /api/misc-expenses still rejects travel/food; accepts parking (regression)

failed.issue: Phase 3 Feature 1 (Driver downloads PDF salary slip) is not implemented on /driver/payroll. MyPayroll.js has no imports of pdfGenerator and no Download PDF button. Only admin PayrollView.js triggers generateSalarySlipPDF.
failed.evidence: grep 'Download|PDF|pdfGenerator' /app/frontend/src/pages/MyPayroll.js -> no matches. UI screenshot of /driver/payroll shows only 'Final Amount Paid ₹25,000' with no download button.

failed.issue: GET /api/drivers/{driver_id}/attendance/{year}/{month} still returns null (no return statement in attendance_enhancements.py handler). MyAttendance page therefore keeps showing 'No attendance records'.
failed.evidence: Reported and unfixed since iteration 9; not re-tested this pass but no code change observed.

action_items: Add Download PDF (and optionally Excel) button to /app/frontend/src/pages/MyPayroll.js: import { generateSalarySlipPDF } from '../utils/pdfGenerator' and wire a handler that fetches /api/payroll/{driver_id}/{year}/{month} for the selected month and calls generateSalarySlipPDF(payrollData, driverInfo). Keep the driver UI free of daily-payout numbers except via the PDF export.
Fix GET /api/drivers/{driver_id}/attendance/{year}/{month} in /app/backend/attendance_enhancements.py to return the merged monthly attendance JSON (still returns null).
